title: The Sunken Ziggurat of Arakeph
theme: Sand-buried desert temple with exposed platforms, sunken chambers, wind-cut paths, and hidden lower passages
hook: A three-day windstorm has uncovered the top of an ancient ziggurat. By dawn, a black doorway was visible in the sand, and by noon, the dunes around it began to move against the wind.
background: Arakeph was a sun-priest archive built around a sealed lower reliquary. The upper temple collapsed into the dunes after its keepers buried a dangerous prophecy beneath the main stair. Now shifting sand exposes old platforms while hiding safer passages below.

connections.note: Concealed under-sand crawl below the entrance stair

playerSafe.description: A sand-buried temple ruin with exposed platforms, dune trails, broken causeways, and sunken lower chambers.

layout.notes: Sand-buried temple with exposed upper platforms, diagonal dune trails, sunken chambers, blocked thresholds, and hidden under-sand passages.

rooms.name: Wind-Cut Entrance Stair
rooms.readAloud: A stair of sun-bleached stone descends between dunes. Sand pours over each step in thin streams, whispering around a half-buried doorway.
rooms.gmNotes: The entrance is safe if crossed steadily. A concealed under-sand crawl can be found by brushing sand from the lowest left-hand step.

inhabitants.name: Dune Vermin
inhabitants.tactics: Burst from sand pockets, distract pack animals, retreat through cracks
inhabitants.morale: Scatter if exposed to loud metal chimes
inhabitants.wants: Shade, crumbs, and cool stone cracks
inhabitants.leverage: Can be baited with water drops or dried dates

rooms.treasure: A sun-worn bronze stair marker shaped like a tiny ziggurat.
rooms.secrets: A concealed under-sand crawl below the entrance stair leads to Room 7.
rooms.exits: Wind-cut trail to Room 2, concealed under-sand crawl to Room 7.

rooms.name: Exposed Sun Court
rooms.readAloud: A broad courtyard lies open to the sky. Only the tops of old walls remain, and dunes have filled the corners like pale water.
rooms.gmNotes: This is the surface hub. Sand shifts across inscriptions every few minutes, revealing clue fragments in changing order.
rooms.treasure: A cracked tile showing the sun above a buried eye.
rooms.secrets: The inscriptions describe a lower chamber deliberately hidden under the main stair.
rooms.exits: Wind-cut trail to Room 1, dune trail to Room 3, narrow ledge down to Room 5.

rooms.name: Half-Buried Colonnade
rooms.readAloud: Broken columns stand in uneven rows, their bases swallowed by sand. Shadows stripe the floor where roof stones once rested.
rooms.gmNotes: The colonnade gives cover and sightlines. A careful party can read column shadows to predict the next sand shift.

inhabitants.name: Sun-Bleached Bandits
inhabitants.tactics: Use columns as cover, retreat toward open sun, barter if outnumbered
inhabitants.morale: Yield if offered water and a safe way out
inhabitants.wants: Relics light enough to carry before the temple sinks again
inhabitants.leverage: Know which columns mark safe footing

rooms.treasure: A linen-wrapped column cap etched with travel prayers.
rooms.secrets: One column is hollow and carries wind from Room 4.
rooms.exits: Dune trail to Room 2, exposed causeway to Room 4.

rooms.name: Sand-Choked Offering Hall
rooms.readAloud: Sand has filled the old offering hall nearly to the carved lintel. Bowls, coins, and votive hands poke from the slope.
rooms.gmNotes: Digging too quickly triggers a sliding sand hazard. Patient work reveals offerings and a safer causeway edge toward Room 5.

inhabitants.name: Glass-Eyed Scarabs
inhabitants.tactics: Boil from offering bowls, blind with glittering wings, vanish into sand
inhabitants.morale: Retreat if the offering bowls are covered
inhabitants.wants: To keep offerings buried and undisturbed
inhabitants.leverage: Follow old incense or polished copper

rooms.treasure: A handful of old votive coins fused by desert heat.
rooms.secrets: The newest offering is fresh, proving someone entered recently.
rooms.exits: Exposed causeway to Room 3, buried causeway down to Room 5.

rooms.name: Broken Ziggurat Tier
rooms.readAloud: A cracked platform juts from the sand like the prow of a stone ship. Below it, a darker stair disappears into a sunken gap.
rooms.gmNotes: This transition area defines the vertical burial. Sand slides can separate the party if they move carelessly near the edge.
rooms.treasure: A gold-dusted plumb weight used by temple builders.
rooms.secrets: A carved arrow hidden under sand points to the sealed reliquary below.
rooms.exits: Narrow ledge to Room 2, buried causeway to Room 4, collapsed ledge to Room 6, unstable stair to Room 8.

rooms.name: Sunken Inscription Room
rooms.readAloud: The room is lower than the rest of the ruin, cool and dim beneath a ceiling of packed sand. Inscriptions cover every visible stone.
rooms.gmNotes: The inscriptions explain that the lower reliquary was sealed to prevent a prophecy from being stolen. Reading them aloud wakes the sandbound spirits.

inhabitants.name: Sandbound Scribes
inhabitants.tactics: Speak through falling sand, obscure false readers, test intent with riddles
inhabitants.morale: Help anyone who copies a truth without stealing the original
inhabitants.leverage: Respectful transcription and water poured on hot stone

rooms.treasure: A clay seal stamped with the ziggurat name.
rooms.secrets: One inscription names the sealed lower reliquary and its guardian vow.
rooms.exits: Collapsed ledge to Room 5, narrow tunnel to Room 7.

rooms.name: Hidden Under-Sand Crawl
rooms.readAloud: A cramped passage runs beneath the dunes. Roots of ancient plaster hang from the ceiling, and the air smells of hot dust and old resin.
rooms.gmNotes: This route is hidden from the entrance and cramped enough to make retreat tense. It lets players bypass the exposed court if found early.
rooms.treasure: A sealed resin tube containing a map fragment of the lower stair.
rooms.secrets: The crawl was built as an escape route for reliquary keepers.
rooms.exits: Narrow tunnel to Room 6, concealed under-sand crawl to Room 1.

rooms.name: Sealed Lower Reliquary
rooms.readAloud: A chamber of warm shadow waits below the main stair. A stone sunburst seals a black niche, and sand falls upward in thin golden streams.
rooms.gmNotes: The finale can be solved by restoring the copied warning, bargaining with the guardian, or sealing the prophecy again. Breaking the niche releases a violent sand surge.

inhabitants.name: The Sunken Vow
inhabitants.tactics: Moves through falling sand, blocks exits with dunes, tests whether intruders came to preserve or steal
inhabitants.morale: Relents if the warning is preserved without opening the black niche
inhabitants.wants: The sealed prophecy kept from ambitious rulers
inhabitants.leverage: Accepts truthful copies, restored seals, and promises witnessed by sunlight

rooms.treasure: A sunburst reliquary seal, a copied prophecy warning, and a cool black stone that points north at dawn.
rooms.secrets: The prophecy is dangerous because it names a conqueror who has not been born yet.

gmNotes: Let sand change the map fiction without changing the actual route graph.
Surface areas should feel exposed and hot; lower areas should feel cooler, darker, and more dangerous.
The hidden crawl rewards careful search at the entrance and gives a non-obvious bypass.
The twist is that the reliquary protects the world from a prophecy, not treasure from thieves.
